You may speak for as long as you wish.
What are the steps involved when people have to do laundry?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: First, sort the clothes by colour and check the care labels and pockets, then put a load in the machine, add detergent, and choose the right wash cycle. When it’s finished, hang the clothes up or tumble-dry them if the labels allow, then fold them and put them away.
